research_question: With the same session-binary unit, S_i, causal history, full candidates and denominators, how does restricting arbitrary unordered session cooccurrence to directed adjacent-basket association change next-basket validation NDCG?
interpretation: Joint change of direction and adjacency; does not isolate either effect. Custom D1 association score, not standard first-order Markov or a probability; no claim that it solves cold items.

reference_identity.reuse: Read accepted reference bytes; never refit, rerank, regenerate or edit P0/C1 outputs; C1 pairs are an audit upper bound, not a tunable D1 blend.

fit.boundary: Take original adjacent baskets only when both endpoints are train and within cutoff; never connect warmup to train, train to validation, or across a removed/missing index. A session crossing cutoff is retained only through eligible train endpoints; no end-based session deletion.
fit.shared_support: Use byte-identical C1 S_i: count of train session item sets containing i, including singleton-only and no-transition items; no primary support refit. Independent oracle reconstructs S_i only to audit equality.
fit.directed_count: D_ij = number of train sessions with at least one original adjacent eligible basket pair (A,B) where i in A, j in B and i != j. Count each ordered (i,j) at most once per session; reverse direction is separate.
fit.cross_basket_product: Every A x B pair except i=j is eligible; no averaging by basket size and no invented order within either unordered same-ms basket.
invariants: S_i positive keys exactly equal frozen C1 support and P0 positive keys; do not replace by D1 outgoing keys
For each stored edge: i != j and integer 0 < D_ij <= C1_C_ij <= min(S_i,S_j)
D_ij and D_ji need not match; their sum may exceed C1_C_ij
sum_(i,j) D_ij equals sum_s number of distinct directed edges in eligible train session s
sum D <= 2 * sum C1_C; distinct global D edges <= 2 * distinct global C1 pairs; these are count bounds, not raw scan-work or runtime bounds
Singleton/no-transition sessions add zero D edges but remain in shared S_i; no-transition keys must not disappear

history.source: same accepted baskets.csv exact session/current-query join as C1
history.set: Distinct union of same-session baskets through query_ms and basket_index inclusive, including current basket; identical to stored C1 query history
history.multiplicity: Each distinct seed once; no last-N cap, recency weight or last-basket-only substitution
history.unknown_seed: Keep trace; S_i absent gives exact zero, never divide by zero or drop query
history.missing_or_empty_current_join: Stop; accepted current basket is nonempty, so this is not a fallback condition

ranking.catalog: All accepted catalog IDs with first_view_ms < query_ms; same complete causal catalog as C1/P0
ranking.score: sum(D_ij / S_i for distinct i in H(q) if i != j and S_i > 0); absent directed edge contributes zero
ranking.arithmetic: exact reduced rational; no floating tie tolerance
ranking.full_fallback: If every causal candidate has zero D1 score, exactly reuse P0 full-catalog order
ranking.partial_fallback: Fill zero-score slots by full frozen P0-count/numeric-ID order over all causal candidates, excluding already chosen IDs; not a truncated P0 top10 append
ranking.unknown_candidate: Retain every candidate. Missing D1 edges contribute zero; independently look up the frozen P0 count and use zero only if that P0 key is absent. A candidate without D1 incoming/outgoing evidence can still have positive P0 count, which must remain unchanged for tie/fill.
ranking.short_catalog: Return min(10, candidate_count) unique IDs; no padding
ranking.empty_catalog: Empty rank; keep nonempty-target query with zero retrieval metrics
ranking.exact_optimization: All directed outgoing neighbors for all history seeds plus proven full zero-score complement; no top-L/ANN/sample/candidate cap
audit_bounds: D1 candidate scores <= C1 scores mathematically at the same H and S; this does not order retrieval metrics
D1 positive candidate set is a subset of C1 positive set; supported-seed count using S is identical
Every C1 no-positive-evidence query must also fully fall back in D1; the converse need not hold

evaluation.roster: queries.csv exact validation role; three-way complete key and stored order equality with C1 queries.jsonl and P0 outputs
evaluation.missing_extra_duplicate_policy: Stop; never inner-join away a query
evaluation.secondary_comparison: D1-P0 differences are descriptive only; preserve original C1-P0 report as historical reference
evaluation.metrics: Unchanged P0 v1 full-target NDCG/Recall/HitRate/MRR, visitor-macro NDCG and common-union coverage; full target includes unreachable items
evaluation.conditional: Same 161211 all-targets-reachable queries, separate descriptive denominator; never substitute for main
evaluation.nonfinite: forbidden; explicit null plus reason for undefined groups
evaluation.source_exposure: P0 and C1 validation, diagnostics and intervals were observed before D1 selection; future D1 is a new exposed-development comparison, not a pristine holdout.

fixed_validation.interpretation: copied from accepted P0/data receipts; C1 item-support keys must equal P0 positive keys, so these historical support partitions remain identical

uncertainty.reference_value: Round-trip binary64 C1 NDCG from accepted C1 query JSONL; copy original P0 values for descriptive D1-P0
uncertainty.reduction: Per-query D1 binary64 minus copied C1 binary64; main math.fsum in accepted query order. Per-visitor d_v=math.fsum in within-visitor query order; each replicate math.fsum(w_v*d_v in numeric visitor order)/sum(w_v*n_v) with exact integer denominator. Do not average visitor means.
uncertainty.audit_reuse: Verify each draw SHA (little-endian signed int64), RNG before/after and sampled query denominator against accepted C1 bootstrap; compute NEW D1-C1 deltas and interval in D1 namespace only. Never copy C1-P0 deltas/interval as D1 results.
uncertainty.multiple_comparison_policy: One prespecified primary contrast only. No simultaneous two-control superiority claim or new family-wise inference. All secondary differences descriptive.
uncertainty.interpretation: Conditional exposed-development resampling only; report unfavorable or cross-zero interval unchanged, no automatic model selection/test unlock.

slices_and_diagnostics.shared_membership: Exact inherited C1/P0 visitor seen/new, current/target one/multiple, original train activity 0/1/2-5/6+, and target support based on shared frozen C1 S_i/P0 positive keys
slices_and_diagnostics.small_group_rule: descriptive_only; no removal/merge/tuning or slice CI; original train/test and Olist/UCI restrictions retained
slices_and_diagnostics.cold_reference: 11943 all-zero shared-support target queries had zero C1/P0 NDCG, Recall, HitRate and MRR; coverage is not asserted zero. This is not a prediction of D1 performance, and does not mean all targets are unreachable or never seen.
D1_extra_diagnostics: history seeds with at least one D1 outgoing edge; not a replacement support definition
incoming-edge target coverage: all/mixed/none, complete denominator, descriptive only
positive causal candidate count 0 / 1-9 / at_least_10 and zero-fill slots
mutually exclusive reason: positive_evidence; else no_shared_supported_seed; else no_outgoing_seed; else no_positive_causal_neighbor
C1 full-fallback implies D1 full-fallback; report extra D1 fallback without dropping queries

resources_and_next_entry.train_only_preflight: Before real D1 fit, independently count original adjacent train basket pairs, raw cross-products excluding diagonal, repeated directed emissions and per-session unique edge totals/maxima; temporary per-session sets only, no global D1 table. Role metadata may be scanned for filtering; decode item arrays only for train baskets, never validation/test item arrays or targets; no validation/test ranking.
resources_and_next_entry.counts_to_reconcile: raw=sum_adj(|A|*|B|-|A intersection B|); unique=sum_s|E_s|; sum fitted D_ij=unique. Raw can exceed 2*sum C1_C due to repeats; no raw/runtime promise from bound.
resources_and_next_entry.budget_scope: Future one D1 fit + full validation + bootstrap + independent acceptance; cooperative checks, exact checkpoint placement frozen at implementation entry; not OS-hard instantaneous guarantee
resources_and_next_entry.on_exceed: Stop and preserve started/failure/partial evidence; no sampling, truncation, relaxed denominator or silent retry
resources_and_next_entry.entry_gate: Implement D1, three-arm adapter, bootstrap and independent synthetic oracle first; then train-only cost audit and separately frozen real-validation entry. This spec does not implement or launch that entry.

reserved_test.rule: Preserve P0 eight technical/identity/explicit-scope gates and C1 final-choice restriction; favorable development result or this specification cannot open test. No final-refit/test command this round.

synthetic_cases: direction and reverse independence, reverse sum may exceed C1 pair
repeat direction in one session counts once, across sessions increments
singleton and no-transition S keys retained
unordered same-ms baskets: cross product across adjacent baskets only, diagonal removed
original index gaps and role boundaries never bridged
future rows cannot change train D or shared S
same full C1 history, unseen visitor with valid current context, unknown seeds
known S but no outgoing vs incoming-only candidate remains eligible
rational ties, full P0 fallback and exact zero complement
pointwise D<=C1 and positive-set subset, without metric-order claim
three-way missing/extra/duplicate query and full-target denominator cases
primary cluster-weighted bootstrap versus incorrect iid/query or visitor-mean methods
new D1 deltas with identical old C1 draw SHA/RNG/denominators, independent percentile
planned_acceptance.independent_oracle: Separate SQL/relational original adjacent basket join and DISTINCT(session,i,j), independent shared S reconstruction and equality check, counts/lineage conservation, exact rational complete ranking with full zero complement, independent Decimal/Fraction metrics, all nested query values and all bootstrap replicates; no sampled acceptance.
artifacts: model directed counts and fit identity, shared-support descriptor
per-session original adjacency/directed-set lineage and exclusion/boundary accounting
complete per-query H trace, exact scores/ranks/candidate counts, copied controls and metric terms
three-arm aggregates, main D1-C1 and descriptive D1-P0 deltas with slices
new bootstrap records with old draw identity audit
planned_acceptance.reentry: Complete verify-only; partial evidence preserved and replay/overwrite refused
planned_acceptance.publication: Only code, specification and aggregate receipts public; raw/ID-level/models/draws remain Git ignored inside shop

limitations: Validation P0 and C1 results were exposed before selection; D1 is not unseen validation or final testing
D1 jointly changes direction and adjacency, not a single isolated causal direction effect
Shared S normalization and complete H make this a custom association score, not standard first-order MC or a probability
No new item content; train-unsupported cold-item gap remains; new visitor with current history is not context-free cold start
No conversion/revenue/causal/commercial deployment claim; existing CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 conditions and Olist/UCI restrictions retained
change_control: New D1 protocol only; preserve P0/C1, their release ZIP/receipts and parent contracts byte-for-byte. Any change to relation/count unit/S/history/self-edge/fallback/candidates/metrics/inference requires a new version before execution; no alternate D1 variants in this round.
